transcript.text: Hi everyone! As you may know, I have one unused parking space in my narrow driveway available for the summer, running June 1 through July 31. I'd like to get the full period covered, and I'm looking for someone who can handle repainting the faded curb numbers and sweeping the driveway weekly. If you're interested in parking there, please submit a complete offer through my round-robin offer-recording step — covering payment, dates, access, vehicle, and upkeep — before we discuss any follow-up details. And if you're a nearby resident with any practical driveway concerns, please submit those as well. Once I have all the original offers and concerns, I'll make my final decision.
